summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric utility listed on BYMA and the NYSE, disclosed via Form -6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares under Article 64 of Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. CPSA bought 120,000 shares on BYMA at AR$2,023.41 for AR$242,809,363; Proener bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 shares) on the NYSE at USD12.62 for USD378,767.86, both settled October 8, 2026. Acquisitions stayed under 25% of the prior 90-day average daily volume; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch buyback pace, ADR/local spread, and authorization limits.
